## Summary

Operator-run end-to-end verification on a real Steam account that automatic follow detection unlocks the bonus game, plus a graceful-degradation re-check. Satisfies parent AC2.

**Status: awaiting operator execution (2026-09-30).** The agent cannot run this: it needs a **Windows x64 host with a real Steam client and account**, which is not provisioned in the agent environment. Per the producer, do **not** assume the client is logged in — verify both the logged-in automatic path and the not-logged-in / Steam-absent fallbacks. The implementation (P1–P5) is complete and pushed to `dev`; `docs/dev/steam-follow-qa.md` is updated with the automatic-detection path.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] With the addon built into the package and Steam **logged in**, `SteamworksFollowSource.followCheckSupported` becomes `true` on a real Steam session and automatic unlock is verified end-to-end (designated bonus unlocked, no manual claim).
- [ ] With the addon present but **no user logged in**, the launcher does not crash, `isFollowing` returns `false`, the bonus stays locked, and the manual claim remains available (no fabricated follow).
- [ ] The unlock persists across a relaunch without re-verification.
- [ ] With Steam absent, the launcher boots, the bonus stays locked, and every non-gated game remains playable (no crash).
- [ ] Evidence (screenshots/notes) is recorded and the known-limitation note in `docs/dev/steam-follow-qa.md` is removed or updated (already rewritten in P5; confirm on the real build).
- [ ] Parent `CG-0MUN7930Y009X8Z1` AC2 is satisfied.

## Operator Steps

1. On Windows x64: `npm install steamworks.js && npm run build:steam-friends && npm run package:steam`.
2. Execute `docs/dev/steam-follow-qa.md` (sections 1–6), recording Pass/Fail/N/A and evidence per step.
3. Record the results as a comment on this item.

## Dependencies

- Blocked by P4 and P5 (both complete).

## Deliverables

- QA evidence comment + any QA-document corrections found on the real build.

## Key Files

- `docs/dev/steam-follow-qa.md`

# Core icon-linkage mechanism and scaffold tests

**Parent:** CG-0MUUFZSE90061KKL (Wire the app icon into each tce-<game> repo entry).

## Goal

Extend the scaffold's shared-asset linkage so the core's root app-icon files
compose into a scaffolded/refreshed game repo's `public/` root, giving every
`tce-<game>` a single-source-of-truth icon set.

## Scope

- Add `sharedPublicRoot` to `scripts/configs/repo-layout.json` enumerating the
  six core root app-icon files: `favicon.svg`, `apple-touch-icon.png`,
  `icon-32.png`, `icon-192.png`, `icon-512.png`, `site.webmanifest`.
- Add exported `linkSharedPublicAssets(gameRepoRoot, coreRoot)` to
  `scripts/game-repo-scaffold.ts`, reusing the `linkSharedAssets()` symlink
  semantics (idempotent, relative targets, plain file symlink with a
  copy/junction fallback).
- Call it from `scaffoldGameRepo()` and surface the created links in the
  scaffold result.
- Keep `core/public/favicon.svg` the single source of truth.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Core asset-linkage single source of truth: the scaffold's shared-asset linkage (`scripts/game-repo-scaffold.ts`, driven by `scripts/configs/repo-layout.json`) exposes the core root app-icon files (`favicon.svg`, `apple-touch-icon.png`, `icon-32.png`, `icon-192.png`, `icon-512.png`, `site.webmanifest`) into a scaffolded/refreshed game repo's `public/` root, derived from the tracked `core/public/` files — no hand-copied divergent icon binaries.
- `scripts/configs/repo-layout.json` declares the six root icon files in a `sharedPublicRoot` list.
- `scaffoldGameRepo()` invokes the new linkage and the returned result lists the created root icon links.
- Automated validation: `tests/scripts/game-repo-scaffold.test.ts` asserts the six root icon files are linked into a temp game repo's `public/` and that a second run is a no-op; the core unit suite (`npx vitest run --project unit tests/scripts/`) and `npm run build` pass.
- Core changes committed and pushed to the core `dev` branch (never `main`), with the commit hash recorded on this work item.

## Definition of Done

- Mechanism implemented; the root-icon linkage is driven from `repo-layout.json` (no hard-coded file list in code).
- Tests written before/with the code and passing; build green.
- Pushed to core `dev`; commit hash recorded on the core work item.

**Key Files:**

- `scripts/configs/repo-layout.json` — add the `sharedPublicRoot` list.
- `scripts/game-repo-scaffold.ts` — add `linkSharedPublicAssets()` and wire it into `scaffoldGameRepo()`.
- `tests/scripts/game-repo-scaffold.test.ts` — new linkage tests.
- `public/favicon.svg` — authoritative source file (no change expected).
